title: Lagged Treasury General Account drawdown liquidity support for BTC long or cash
thesis: A current U.S. Treasury General Account weekly average strictly below its value four eligible observations earlier may identify an all-else-equal reserve-liquidity state with better subsequent BTC return and path-risk evidence than drain-or-neutral weeks.
mechanism: Use official WTREGEN Wednesday-ending observations only from Friday 00:00 UTC, compare each value with the observation exactly four weeks earlier, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. The supportive state is strictly lower TGA; no threshold, smoothing, alternate lag, direction inversion or combined macro factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish predictive direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold full BTC during supportive weeks and zero-yield cash otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration while explicitly charging lost upside and capital utilization.
